sanskrit: agneḥ prajātaṃ pari yad dhiraṇyam amṛtaṃ dadhre adhi martyeṣu | ya enad veda sa id enad arhati jarāmṛtyur bhavati yo bibharti ||
english: That gold which was born from Agni and holds immortality among mortals — he alone is worthy of it who knows it; he who bears it attains death by old age.

sanskrit: yad dhiraṇyaṃ sūryeṇa suvarṇaṃ prajāvanto manavaḥ pūrva īṣire | tat tvā candraṃ varcasā saṃ sṛjāty āyuṣmān bhavati yo bibharti ||
english: That gold, the good gold, which the progenitive men of old obtained through the sun — with that, gleaming, it unites you with vital lustre; he who bears it becomes rich in long life.

sanskrit: āyuṣe tvā varcase tvā- -ojase ca balāya ca | yathā hiraṇya tejasā vibhāsāsi janām̐ anu ||
english: For long life I bind you, for lustre, for vigour, and for strength — so that you, O gold, may shine with your brilliance among the people.

sanskrit: yad veda rājā varuṇo veda devo bṛhaspatiḥ | indro yad vṛtrahā veda tat ta āyuṣyaṃ bhuvat tat te varcasyaṃ bhuvat ||
english: What king Varuṇa knows, what the god Bṛhaspati knows, what Indra the slayer of Vṛtra knows — let that become life-force for you, let that become vital lustre for you.

sanskrit: yad ābadhnan dākṣāyaṇā hiraṇyaṃ śatānīkāya sumanasyamānāḥ | tat te badhnāmi śataśāradāya- -āyuṣmān jaradaṣṭir yathāsaḥ ||
english: The gold which the Dākṣāyaṇas bound with goodwill upon Śatānīka — that same I bind upon you for a hundred autumns, so that you may be long-lived and reach old age with teeth intact.

sanskrit: nainaṃ rakṣāṃsi na piśācāḥ sahante devānām ojaḥ prathamajaṃ hy etat | yo bibharti dākṣāyaṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ sa jīveṣu kṛṇute dīrgham āyuḥ ||
english: Neither demons nor piśācas can overpower this, for it is the firstborn vigour of the gods; he who wears the Dākṣāyaṇa gold secures long life among the living.

sanskrit: apāṃ reto jyotir ojo balaṃ ca vanaspatīnām uta vīryāṇi | indra ivendriyam ava rudhmo asmin sa dakṣamāṇo bibharad dhiraṇyam ||
english: The seed of the waters, the light, the vigour and strength of the forest lords, and their vital powers — as Indra holds his lordly might, so we enclose all this in him; let him, thriving in power, bear the gold.

sanskrit: samānāṃ māsām ṛtubhiṣ ṭvāhaṃ saṃvatsarasya payasā piparmi | indrāgnī tvā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānāv āyuṣmantam uttamaṃ tvā karātaḥ ||
english: I fill you, in accord with the seasons' months, with the nourishment of the full year; may Indra and Agni, growing great through the sacred formulation, make you long-lived and supreme.

sanskrit: yat te catasraḥ pradiśo mano jagāma dūrakam | tat ta ā vartayāmasi- -iha kṣayāya jīvase ||
english: Whatever of your mind has gone afar to the four cardinal directions — that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living.
Whatever of your mind has gone to the four-cornered earth — [that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living].
Whatever of your mind has gone to Yama Vaivasvata — [that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living].
Whatever of your mind has gone to the billowing ocean — [that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living].

sanskrit: yat te divaṃ yat pṛthivīṃ manaḥ (…) ||
english: Whatever of your mind has gone to the sky and to the earth — [that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living].
Whatever of your mind has gone to Vāyu and the mid-region — [that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living].

sanskrit: yat te sūryaṃ yad uṣasaṃ manaḥ (…) ||
english: Whatever of your mind has gone to the sun and to the dawn — [that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living].
Whatever of your mind has gone to the moon and the stars — [that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living].

sanskrit: yat ta āpo yad oṣadhīr manaḥ (…) ||
english: Whatever of your mind has gone to the waters and the herbs — [that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living].

sanskrit: yat te parāṃ parāvataṃ mano jagāma dūrakam | tat ta ā vartayāmasi- -iha kṣayāya jīvase ||
english: Whatever of your mind has gone to the far-most distance, the remotest beyond — that we bring back to you here, for dwelling, for living.
